create_feishu_channel: create a FeishuChannel instance connected to a MessageBus with app_id and app_secret config
build_feishu_card_message: build a Feishu interactive card message with markdown content rendered in a chat
send_feishu_reply: send a Feishu card reply to a chat thread with running status updates and final result
upload_feishu_file: upload an image or file to Feishu and send it as a message in a chat thread
receive_feishu_file: receive and download a Feishu file attachment from an inbound message to local storage
